title: “Since Lawyers are Males..”: Examining Implicit Gender Bias in Hindi Language Generation by LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM responses to ambiguous queries containing gender-neutral occupations and gender-specific verbs/pronouns to determine if models rely on occupational and behavioral stereotypes instead of recognizing grammatical ambiguity.

Comparing the frequency of gender-biased model responses across identical prompts presented in English, Devanagari-script Hindi, and Anglicized Hindi to measure how language representation and script influence bias.

Analyzing model responses to identify if lower social class or lower power hierarchy professions are disproportionately associated with females, and higher-status professions with males, within the context of gender ambiguity.
